import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem compact_core_countable_trace_basis {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X]
    (x : X) (U : Set X) (hU : U ∈ nhds x) :
    ∃ V : Set X, V ∈ nhds x ∧ IsCompact V ∧ V ⊆ U ∧
      ∃ B : Set (Set X), Set.Countable B ∧ TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis B ∧
        ∀ W ∈ nhds x, ∃ b ∈ B, x ∈ b ∧ b ∩ V ⊆ W ∩ V := by
  obtain ⟨r, hrpos, hrU⟩ := Metric.nhds_basis_closedBall.mem_iff.mp hU
  have hV_nhds : Metric.closedBall x r ∈ nhds x := Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds x hrpos
  have hV_compact : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall x r) := Metric.isClosed_closedBall.isCompact
  refine ⟨Metric.closedBall x r, hV_nhds, hV_compact, hrU, ?_⟩
  haveI : SecondCountableTopology X := inferInstance
  refine ⟨countableBasis X, countable_countableBasis X, isBasis_countableBasis X, ?_⟩
  intro W hW
  obtain ⟨b, hbB, hxb, hbW⟩ := (isBasis_countableBasis X).mem_nhds_iff.mp hW
  exact ⟨b, hbB, hxb, Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ hbW⟩

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem compact_core_countable_trace_basis {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X]
    (x : X) (U : Set X) (hU : U ∈ nhds x) :
    ∃ V : Set X, V ∈ nhds x ∧ IsCompact V ∧ V ⊆ U ∧
      ∃ B : Set (Set X), Set.Countable B ∧ TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis B ∧
        ∀ W ∈ nhds x, ∃ b ∈ B, x ∈ b ∧ b ∩ V ⊆ W ∩ V := by
  classical
  rcases Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hU with ⟨r, hr, hball⟩
  let V : Set X := Metric.closedBall x (r / 2)
  
  have hVsub : V ⊆ U := by
    intro y hy
    apply hball
    change dist y x ≤ r / 2 at hy
    change dist y x < r
    linarith
  
  have hVnhds : V ∈ nhds x := by
    refine
      Filter.mem_of_superset
        (show Metric.ball x (r / 2) ∈ nhds x from
          Metric.ball_mem_nhds x (by linarith)) ?_
    intro y hy
    change dist y x < r / 2 at hy
    change dist y x ≤ r / 2
    exact le_of_lt hy
  
  have hVcompact : IsCompact V := by
    change IsCompact (Metric.closedBall x (r / 2))
    exact ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall x (r / 2)
  
  have hSecond : SecondCountableTopology X := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨B, hBcount, -, hBbasis⟩ :=
    TopologicalSpace.exists_countable_basis (α := X)
  
  have hTrace :
      ∀ W ∈ nhds x, ∃ b ∈ B, x ∈ b ∧ b ∩ V ⊆ W ∩ V := by
    intro W hW
    rcases hBbasis.mem_nhds_iff.mp hW with ⟨b, hbB, hxb, hbw⟩
    exact ⟨b, hbB, hxb, fun y hy => ⟨hbw hy.1, hy.2⟩⟩
  
  exact ⟨V, hVnhds, hVcompact, hVsub, B, hBcount, hBbasis, hTrace⟩
